body.text: On October 7, 2023, Hamas attacked Israel, killing about 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages. Israel’s ensuing assault on Gaza has killed more than 74,200 Palestinians, including 21,500 children, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. Since the ceasefire was declared on October 10, 2025, at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli drone strikes. According to media reports, Israel had attacked Gaza on 325 of the 361 days counted through October 5, 2026.

Behind these figures are families grieving loved ones, people living through violence and hunger, and a population fighting every moment to survive. This package gathers Frontline’s coverage from the past year, as Palestinians continued to endure these realities under a ceasefire that has offered little respite. It includes book reviews examining antisemitism and the idea of “perfect victimhood”; interviews, including one with the UN Special Rapporteur on the Occupied Palestinian Territories; and essays discussing the region’s future and the legacy powerful countries are leaving for Palestinian children and the wider world.
You can also find Frontline’s two previous packages, covering the two years before this one, for a fuller account of the devastation Palestinians have faced and the forces shaping the region.
